notes: Both flagged two-morpheme units — שֵׂה כְשָׂבִים → *the sheep* and שֵׂה עִזִּים → *the goat* — are retained: rule 30's one-English-word condition is met, the single noun carries the sense of both morphemes, and splitting would leave the generic head noun holding no English of its own. Each heads on the lexeme-carrying morpheme.
The supplied *the* on each animal joins the nominal expression under rule 15; the written article on בְּהֵמָה takes its own *the*, and the copula joins the predicate noun under rule 20.
